body: Just reporting that as of Godot 4.4.1 (stable), this still exists. The original method of reproduction still works, though I will try to provide a more general means to reproduce this bug soon.

This bug no longer occurs in Godot 4.6.

However, another bug that may be related occurs instead (see #115994); though that bug is fairly different from this one, and already has it's own issue. The only reason why I suspect these two are related is the fact that they both effect the same feature. I don't have any specific evidence to confirm this.

If version of Godot before 4.6 wont receive minor patches for bugs such as this, then this issue can be closed.
